title: Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State
abstract: arXiv:2611.26183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over the past three centuries, many thermodynamics researchers have worked to develop fluid equations of state with both high accuracy and broad applicability, proposing various theoretical frameworks and models. Building on these efforts, this study uses Gibbs free energy as the starting point and introduces thermodynamically consistent neural networks to construct a fluid equation of state based on Gibbs free energy (GEoS). This approach establishes a novel machine learning framework that provides a unified representation of fluid states. GEoS performs well on the vapor- and liquid-phase density test sets, with average absolute relative deviations (AARDs) of 5.25% and 3.96%, respectively. It outperforms conventional volume-translated cubic equations of state and existing machine learning models, demonstrating its effectiveness. translated_title: 热力学一致的神经网络用于通用流体吉布斯自由能状态方程
translated_abstract: 在过去三个世纪中，许多热力学研究者致力于开发既具有高精度又具有广泛适用性的流体状态方程，提出了各种理论框架和模型。在这些工作的基础上，本研究以吉布斯自由能为出发点，引入热力学一致的神经网络，构建了基于吉布斯自由能的流体状态方程（GEoS）。该方法建立了一种新颖的机器学习框架，为流体状态提供了统一的表示。GEoS在气相和液相密度测试集上表现良好，平均绝对相对偏差（AARD）分别为5.25%和3.96%。它优于传统的体积平移立方型状态方程和现有的机器学习模型，证明了其有效性。利用UMAP降维方法的进一步分析表明，测试集中的大多数分子……
tldr: 本研究以吉布斯自由能为出发点，提出基于热力学一致神经网络的新型流体状态方程，为流体状态提供统一的机器学习表示，其气液相密度预测精度优于传统体积平移立方型状态方程和现有机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a thermodynamically consistent neural network-based Gibbs free energy equation of state (GEoS), establishing a unified machine learning framework for fluid states that outperforms conventional volume-translated cubic equations of state and existing machine learning models in vapor- and liquid-phase density predictions.
